summary: A message from [[character:milo]] reaches [[character:bill]] at [[location:epsilon-eridani]] while he is raising mosses, lichens and grasses in a farm donut as base stock for seeding [[location:ee-2|Ragnarök]]. Milo's report from [[location:82-eridani]] describes a highly promising colonization prospect, then the approach of missiles, and it carries a record of his vessel's destruction. The differential backup he attached was cut off before completion; judging that forcing a restoration would probably yield a deranged or non-functional copy, Bill has it archived as a memorial. He orders four more version-3 Bobs on top of the four already under construction, all with extra busters, and resolves to make [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]], whom he blames for earlier trouble at Epsilon Eridani and [[location:alpha-centauri]] as well as Milo's loss, pay for it.

updates.current_state: At [[location:epsilon-eridani]], growing plant stock to seed [[location:ee-2|Ragnarök]] and mourning [[character:milo]], he has ordered four more version-3 Bobs beyond the four being built, all with extra busters, to make [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]] pay. He archived Milo's incomplete backup as a memorial.
Lost at [[location:82-eridani]] when hostile missiles destroyed his vessel.

updates.state: [[character:milo]]'s vessel was destroyed there by the hostile missiles that ambushed him; [[character:bill]] blames [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]].

Terraforming plans use two reusable drives to break incoming ice into rainfall, with the required ice expected within about twenty-five years. [[character:bill]] is growing mosses, lichens and grasses in a farm donut to seed it, and [[character:riker]] has promised seed transport.

updates.description: GUPPI, the General Unit Primary Peripheral Interface, offloads tasks for replicants, who keep human limits on multitasking. Its operating system is firmware, and version 2 has enough memory that a personality matrix is contemplated. It handles messages and backups, drones, tracking, [[technology:autofactory]] orders and network defence.
